verdict.reasons: The image correctly displays the target AFP drip-tape cartridge with authentic branding and readable primary logos, without including wrong product families or people. However, the candidate fails because an installed drip-tape line passes directly underneath and into the physical packaging carton. According to the strict guidelines, a package substituted for operating plumbing or used as part of the irrigation flow path is a core defect. Furthermore, there is no visible clearance or soil gap between the carton and the lateral lines; the carton is sitting directly on the line rather than standing on a dry soil island. This creates a physically impossible irrigation geometry and directly conflicts with the specific technical evidence and image QA requirements. Minor text imperfections on the side of the carton are advisory, but the integration with the plumbing is the reason for rejection.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
